description: This Java class defines an Akka actor named PubUpdater that manages cluster membership events, specifically reacting to member removal events in a distributed pub/sub system. It includes methods for creating actor properties, handling messages, and logging.

classes.name: PubUpdater
classes.description: An Akka actor that handles cluster member removal events to update distributed data accordingly.

methods.description: Static factory method to create Props configuration for this actor, requiring a DDataWriter instance.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for this actor, particularly for cluster member removal events and unhandled messages.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Returns the LoggingAdapter for this actor, used for logging purposes.

methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the associated DDataWriter used by this actor.
